subject: Banking
title: Why Banks Are So Profitable
description: A quick, practical guide to Why Banks Are So Profitable.

hook.text: JPMorgan earned $49 billion in profit in 2023. That's more than most countries' GDP. Banking is insanely profitable.

buildup.text: Banks combine interest income, fee income, trading revenue, and wealth management.

discovery.text: Leverage amplifies returns. Banks hold $10 in assets for every $1 in capital.

twist.text: Bank profits are partly subsidized by taxpayers. Deposit insurance, central bank lending.

climax.text: Banking is profitable because it's leveraged, diversified, and backstopped by government.

punchline.text: $49 billion in one year. Leveraged, diversified, and government-backed.

quiz.question: How much profit did JPMorgan earn in 2023?
